content.text: {"Id":"BUG-TRIAGE-149","Title":"Agent Help grok-cli plan output is rejected then echo-fallback answers","Section":"Backlog","Priority":"high","Done":false,"Estimate":null,"Note":null,"Description":["Agent Help sessions create successfully, but helper turns do not return a diagnosis. GrokCliAgentExecutionStrategy launches grok with --permission-mode plan and a 2-minute HelperTimeout. SSE turn-0003 ran 119718ms and returned plan/progress narration; AgentHelpConversationService.LooksLikeProgressOnlyOutput then marks the turn incomplete for missing FINAL ANSWER. Plugin workflow.agenthelp.submitTurn is not in the REPL long-timeout list, so the plugin times out at 30s (then 120s) while the helper is still running. With UseEchoHelperFallback true, later grok-cli and one-shot-cli failures complete as SynthesizeEchoResponse seeded-context text instead of a helper diagnosis or a hard error.","Triage group: triage-group-7d5bfee65e83e18c","Reports: 1"],"TechnicalDetails":["Acceptance criteria:","- An Agent Help grok-cli turn that produces only plan or progress narration is not accepted as a completed diagnosis; the caller sees an incomplete or error status that names the missing FINAL ANSWER contract.","- When a helper CLI run fails, times out, or is unavailable, submitTurn does not return a completed UseEchoHelperFallback synthesized-context answer as if it were a diagnosis.","- workflow.agenthelp.submitTurn through the plugin/REPL waits at least as long as AgentHelp:HelperTimeout so a 2-minute grok-cli run is not cut off at the 30s REPL default.","- A successful grok-cli or one-shot-cli helper turn returns a concrete Agent Help diagnosis that starts with FINAL ANSWER: and is persisted as the assistant transcript, not echo fallback text.","Implementation notes:","- Inspect GrokCliAgentExecutionStrategy.BuildGrokArgumentList: --permission-mode plan plus --effort/--reasoning-effort high encourages plan narration that LooksLikeProgressOnlyOutput rejects.","- ExecuteHelperAsync returns Incomplete for progress-only Success bodies, but any non-Success CLI result with UseEchoHelperFallback true falls through to AgentHelpPromptBuilder.SynthesizeEchoResponse and is stored as status completed.","- Production appsettings set UseEchoHelperFallback: true; AgentHelpOptions.HelperTimeout defaults to 2 minutes; plugins/core/lib-ps/repl-invoke.ps1 Get-ReplMethodTimeoutSeconds does not treat workflow.agenthelp.submitTurn as a long method.","- Do not treat SessionLog.SubmitAsync internal_server_error as this bug; it was only the question the helper failed to answer."],"ImplementationTasks":null,"CompletedDate":null,"DoneSummary":null,"Remaining":null,"PriorityNote":null,"Reference":null,"Phase":null,"DependsOn":null,"FunctionalRequirements":["FR-MCP-TRIAGE-002"],"TechnicalRequirements":["TR-MCP-TRIAGE-004"],"IdempotencyKey":null}
